0001: #!/usr/bin/env python3
0002: """Finite deterministic candidate queue, using the existing generators.
0003: 
0004:     python3 tools/decomp/no_llm_loop.py LogicTimerDescriptor.cpp --provider properties
0005:     python3 tools/decomp/no_llm_loop.py --provider descriptor --limit 3
0006: 
0007: No model construction or calls. Unsupported jobs are retained with a cause.
0008: Use --publish to validate and publish new MATCH definitions in the original TU.
0009: """
0010: import argparse
0011: import hashlib
0012: import json
0013: import os
0014: from pathlib import Path
0015: import re
0016: import time
0017: 
0018: import candidate
0019: import elfdb
0020: import evidence
0021: import ghidra_cpp
0022: import mutate
0023: import publication
0024: 
0025: 
0026: def outline_properties(stage, tu, cls, db, methods=None):
0027:     """Move generated static definitions to their owning TU; weak header code is not a transfer."""
0028:     import descriptors
0029:     header = stage.path / "decomp/include" / descriptors.header_name(cls)
0030:     text = header.read_text()
0031:     masked = mutate.mask(text)
0032:     functions = [f for f in db["functions"].values() if f.get("scope") == cls
0033:                  and f.get("tu") == tu["id"] and re.match(r"(?:Get|Set)_", f.get("method") or "")]
0034:     source = stage.path / "decomp/src" / tu["name"]
0035:     old = source.read_text()
0036:     old_mask = mutate.mask(old)
0037:     edits, bodies, seen = [], [], set()
0038:     for f in functions:
0039:         if methods is not None and f["method"] not in methods:
0040:             continue
0041:         if f["method"] in seen or mutate.definition(old, old_mask, f):
0042:             continue
0043:         seen.add(f["method"])
0044:         pattern = rf"(?m)^([ \t]*)static ([^;\n]*\b{re.escape(f['method'])}\([^\n]*\))\s*\n[ \t]*\{{"
0045:         matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, masked))
0046:         if len(matches) != 1:
0047:             continue
0048:         m = matches[0]
0049:         begin = masked.index("{", m.start())
0050:         end = mutate.matching(masked, begin, "{", "}")
0051:         if end < 0:
0052:             continue
0053:         signature = text[m.start(2):m.end(2)]
0054:         qualifier = re.sub(rf"\b{re.escape(f['method'])}\(", f"{cls}::{f['method']}(" , signature, count=1)
0055:         definition = qualifier + "\n" + text[begin:end + 1]
0056:         if mutate.definition(definition, mutate.mask(definition), f) is None:
0057:             continue
0058:         bodies.append(definition)
0059:         edits.append((m.start(), end + 1, m.group(1) + "static " + signature + ";"))
0060:     for start, end, replacement in sorted(edits, reverse=True):
0061:         text = text[:start] + replacement + text[end:]
0062:     header.write_text(text)
0063:     source.write_text(old.rstrip() + "\n\n" + "\n\n".join(bodies) + "\n")
0064:     return len(bodies)
0065: 
0066: 
0067: def provide(stage, tu, provider, db):
0068:     target = stage.path / "decomp/src" / tu["name"]
0069:     with stage.activate():
0070:         if provider == "descriptor":
0071:             import descriptors
0072:             if target.exists():
0073:                 raise RuntimeError("descriptor constructor provider will not replace an existing TU")
0074:             cls, base, header, source, complete = descriptors.Generator().generate(tu["id"])
0075:             if not complete:
0076:                 raise RuntimeError("descriptor trace incomplete; no candidate published")
0077:             (stage.path / "decomp/include" / descriptors.header_name(cls)).write_text(header)
0078:             target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0079:             target.write_text(source)
0080:         elif provider == "properties":
0081:             import properties
0082:             if not target.exists():
0083:                 raise RuntimeError("property provider needs the descriptor's constructor TU")
0084:             generator = properties.Generator()
0085:             stats = generator.generate(tu["id"])
0086:             if not stats.get("MATCH"):
0087:                 raise RuntimeError("no supported matching property operations: " + str(dict(stats)))
0088:             funcs = [f for f in db["functions"].values() if f["tu"] == tu["id"] and f.get("scope")
0089:                      and re.match(r"(?:Get|Set)_", f.get("method") or "")]
0090:             if not funcs or not outline_properties(stage, tu, funcs[0]["scope"], db, generator.last_matched):
0091:                 raise RuntimeError("no new owning-TU property definitions; header-only weak code is not accepted")
0092:         else:
0093:             raise ValueError(provider)
0094:     return target
0095: 
0096: 
0097: def run(tus, provider, publish=False, limit=3, seconds=120):
0098:     import parallel
0099:     db = elfdb.load_db()
0100:     tasks = {t["name"]: t for t in db["tus"] if t["kind"] == "game" and t["name"].endswith("Descriptor.cpp")}
0101:     names = tus or sorted(tasks)
0102:     missing = set(names) - set(tasks)
0103:     if missing:
0104:         raise ValueError("not a game descriptor TU: " + ", ".join(sorted(missing)))
0105:     work = elfdb.ROOT / "build-decomp/no-llm"
0106:     work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0107:     inputs = evidence.input_digest(db)
0108:     start, results = time.monotonic(), []
0109:     for name in names:
0110:         if len(results) >= limit or time.monotonic() - start >= seconds:
0111:             break
0112:         if publish and parallel.owned_by_others(name):
0113:             results.append({"tu": name, "status": "BLOCKED", "reason": "owned by " + parallel.owned_by_others(name)})
0114:             continue
0115:         key = hashlib.sha256((inputs + provider + name).encode()).hexdigest()
0116:         cache = work / f"{key}.json"
0117:         if cache.exists():
0118:             row = json.loads(cache.read_text())
0119:             if row["status"] != "MATCH":
0120:                 results.append({**row, "cached_failure": True})
0121:                 continue
0122:         stage = publication.Stage()
0123:         started = time.monotonic()
0124:         try:
0125:             target = provide(stage, tasks[name], provider, db)
0126:             row = candidate.evaluate(name, target, publish=publish, stage=stage, incremental=True)
0127:         except (ValueError, RuntimeError, SystemExit, OSError) as error:
0128:             row = {"tu": name, "status": "BLOCKED", "reason": str(error), "attempt": str(stage.path), "published": False}
0129:         row.update(provider=provider, seconds=time.monotonic() - started, inputs_digest=inputs)
0130:         cache.write_text(json.dumps(row, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
0131:         results.append(row)
0132:         # A successful publication changes inputs; independent remaining jobs use the new snapshot.
0133:         if row.get("published"):
0134:             inputs = evidence.input_digest(db)
0135:     report = {"schema": 1, "provider": provider, "results": results,
0136:               "budget": {"limit": limit, "seconds": seconds, "elapsed": time.monotonic() - start},
0137:               "stop": "finite task/time budget or selected queue exhausted"}
0138:     (work / "latest.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
0139:     return report
0140: 
0141: 
0142: def main():
0143:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
0144:     parser.add_argument("tus", nargs="*")
0145:     parser.add_argument("--provider", choices=("descriptor", "properties"), required=True)
0146:     parser.add_argument("--publish", action="store_true")
0147:     parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=3)
0148:     parser.add_argument("--seconds", type=int, default=120)
0149:     args = parser.parse_args()
0150:     if args.limit <= 0 or args.seconds <= 0:
0151:         parser.error("task/time budgets must be positive")
0152:     print(json.dumps(run(args.tus, args.provider, args.publish, args.limit, args.seconds), indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
0153: 
0154: 
0155: if __name__ == "__main__":
0156:     main()
